page.overview:
Who is Oliver Lightload?

"Oliver likes posing as a long-haul trucker, but the truth is he just likes the Top Down Truck Stop. You see, he's actually an online stockbroker, and he lives less than a mile down the road. He likes to pop in once in a while and crack some jokes, take a nap, or just listen to stories from the constantly changing clientele, all on their way to someplace far off and exotic."
